decisions.reason: It is close to the core range, has been shown on its own page for two years, and in a growing market management would be reluctant to reverse a visible, already-supported launch.
As a core-adjacent luminaire with its own product page in both 2023 and 2024, it carries clear public commitment and little sign of failure, so escalation of commitment favors retention.
Although newer, it is close to the established offer and already presented on its own page, which signals enough investment and visibility for management to continue backing it.

Because it builds directly on the firm's modular lighting offer and was given a dedicated page, management is likely to keep it as part of the announced system direction rather than admit a mistaken extension.
This low-voltage canopy supports the firm's existing system logic and has been publicly launched on its own page, so despite being new it is more likely to be defended than withdrawn.

It is the weakest commitment case because it is only mentioned rather than fully featured on its own page, but its fit with the design-led track range and the absence of negative market signals still make keeping it slightly more likely than dropping it.
